question: A box full of dry fruits weighs 12.650 kg. If the weight of the dry fruits is 9 kg 800 g, the weight of the empty box is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert everything to **grams** for faster subtraction: **1 kg = 1000 g**.

**Total weight** = 12650 g

**Dry fruits weight** = 9800 g

**Box weight** = 12650 − 9800 = 2850 g.

**∴ The correct answer is 2850 g.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total weight of **box + dry fruits** = 12.650 kg

Weight of **dry fruits** only = 9 kg 800 g

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04e2c3a67a0f87ba5a38b39d2c2f8affbbc9c2be6ce1b4c95768459b347ea5b4.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Weight of **Empty Box** = **Total Weight** − **Weight of Contents**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Weight = 12.650 × 1000 = 12650 g

⇒ Dry Fruits Weight = (9 × 1000) + 800 = 9800 g

⇒ Weight of Empty Box = 12650 g − 9800 g

⇒ Weight of Empty Box = 2850 g

**∴ The correct answer is 2850 g.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

Standard metric unit for mass is **Kilogram (kg)**. 1 kg = 1000 grams (g) and 1 gram = 1000 milligrams (mg).

Gross vs Net Weight

**Gross Weight** is the total weight (Box + Content). **Net Weight** is the weight of the content only. **Tare Weight** is the weight of the empty container.</p
